summary: Phase 1 Website Claims Correction survives adversarial testing. One case-sensitive banned-literal bypass (1D, 1E, 1G groups) was found and fixed in commit 0aa410bf by adding /i flags. All gate commands pass: phase-w3-claims 20/20, wave2-product-claim-helper 12/12, lint clean, check-types clean. Six non-blocking findings documented (multi-space bypass, ASCII 3x bypass, Wave 2 helper multi-line bypass, docs/pr coverage gap, b2b-solutions scope gap, Tier 2 PO deferrals). Whole-www suite shows the same 11 pre-existing .test.tsx load failures as baseline; no new failures introduced.
nonblocking_findings: A-CASE-INSENSITIVE-1: Case-sensitive banned-literal regexes in groups 1D/1E/1G were bypassed by lowercase variants (gpt-5, school a (coming soon), zero risk, aka 2019). Fixed during audit in commit 0aa410bf by adding /i flags; re-verified all bypass variants now fail.
NB-1: 1A multi-space whitespace bypass — 'nine  products' or 'all  9 products' (double space) bypasses the literal single-space regex. Non-blocking; unusual formatting.
NB-2: 1G ASCII '3x' / '3X' variant bypass — the scoped '3×' regex matches only Unicode U+00D7. Non-blocking; the claim is currently removed and Math page is roadmap-labeled.

NB-3: Wave 2 product-claim-helper classify() is single-line, so a published case study with school name and outcome on separate lines bypasses the A2 consent gate. Non-blocking because 0 published case studies currently exist; defer to Phase 6 when Tier 2 real case studies are reintroduced.

NB-4: Coverage gap — banned literals remain in apps/www-reading-advantage/docs/pr/*.md and apps/www-reading-advantage/measure/{DESIGN,REFACTOR}.md and todo.md. Out of Phase 1 scope per test-strategy section 0.B (source-scoped to apps/www-reading-advantage/src/).

NB-5: b2b-solutions.ts scope coverage — 1B stale-date scan does not explicitly cover locales/components/products/b2b-solutions.ts; whole-source bans do scan it. The 'New for SY2025' badge was already fixed in commit 80231438.
NB-6: Tier 2 [NEEDS-PO] items remain deferred per phase-0-decisions.md and plan.md Phase 6.
